title: Deliver first offline desktop release
description: Linux Arch and Apple Silicon macOS release following docs/PRODUCT.md. Local authoritative journal, retained revisions, internal links, continuous scripture, custom and two built-in plans, safe import/backup and maintained Obsidian export. No sync, sharing or accounts.

title: Confirm proposed interaction and scheduling policies
description: Review docs/PRODUCT.md and docs/DATA-MODEL.md with the user. Confirm four-stream progression/looping/carry-over, MCheyne start date and leap-day policy, published versus working revisions, autosave cadence, trash/export behavior, and working name. Preserve confirmed requirements without reopening them.
acceptance_criteria: Record accepted defaults and unresolved alternatives in decision records; do not claim user approval prematurely.

title: Implement read-only migration from the original application
description: Inventory legacy flat/nested Markdown and state snapshot, preserve raw sources/unknown metadata, two-pass links, idempotent import ledger and dry-run report. Do not copy destructive migrateEntries or import absolute paths.
acceptance_criteria: Repeat/interrupted imports retain counts and IDs; CRLF/quoted/date-only/malformed inputs and duplicate filenames are handled; originals byte-identical; unsupported source history reported honestly.

title: Validate complete experience and package Linux and macOS release
description: Integrate all modules; test real SQLite/file failures and real desktop behavior; establish signing/distribution decision and reproducible release artifacts. New app uses separate application identifier/data directory from legacy app.
acceptance_criteria: Both devices pass reading/journaling/export/backup/migration acceptance; all required checks pass; release notes state no sync; rollback preserves original app and source journals.

title: Verify translation sources and offline permissions
description: Investigate official provider availability, edition identity, attribution, offline download and distribution terms for LSB, NASB1995, ESV and KJV. Existing API access is not sufficient evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Document primary sources and source-to-app edition mapping; use synthetic text fixtures until approved content handling is established.

title: Prove native shell editor and SQLite persistence on both desktops
description: Evaluate proposed Tauri React Rust SQLite boundary and editor candidates before implementation. Use a separate worktree. Prove transactional saves, crash recovery, backup support, Markdown/link round trips, IME, and packaged app startup on Linux and Apple Silicon.
acceptance_criteria: Record selected bindings/editor and measured evidence on both platforms; distinguish CI compilation from actual native smoke tests. No sync service or unrestricted webview SQL.

title: Implement journal revisions drafts and internal relationships
description: Implement docs/DATA-MODEL.md invariants, immutable complete snapshots, working/published heads, revision generation concurrency, stable links/backlinks, search, trash and explicit purge.
acceptance_criteria: Every persisted autosave is retained under agreed policy; crash/out-of-order/restore/link-rename tests pass; rebuilding derived queries preserves results.
notes: Final design review adds atomic Finish semantics: flush exact pending editor generation and publish it in the same transaction; reject stale finish requests. Every persisted autosave is retained.

title: Implement offline scripture and unrestricted continuous reader
description: Implement structured passage references, four translations, validated resumable offline downloads and chapter-window reader with anchor preservation. Plan selection must not bound scrolling.
acceptance_criteria: Scroll backward/forward across books including short chapters; preserve anchor on switch/resize; cancellation never reports download success; failed persistence is visible.

title: Implement versioned custom plans and both starting plans
description: Support custom explicit schedules and chapter streams, versioned enrollment and completion history, validated import/export and editor. Include MCheyne and OT minus Psalms/Proverbs, NT, Psalms, Proverbs one chapter daily each.
acceptance_criteria: Apply agreed progression policies; changing plan definitions preserves completed assignments; streams advance independently; no scrolling-based completion.

title: Implement Read Write Revisit and starter template
description: Build keyboard-accessible adaptive desktop flows, pinned multi-passage drafts, internal entry links/backlinks, browsing/search, revision inspection and one blank template. Drafts survive layout and navigation changes.
acceptance_criteria: Run product acceptance scenarios, including draft restore, no silent retargeting, named saving/error state, stable entry links and editing existing entries without exporting unfinished changes.

title: Implement incremental maintained Obsidian and standalone Markdown export
description: Implement docs/PORTABILITY.md managed export, stable filenames, published-head projection, receipts, external edit detection, same-path trash notices, destination ownership and explicit reassociation.
acceptance_criteria: Failure injection converges; conflicts preserve external bytes; 20000-entry/3-change benchmark touches only changed or dependent files; plaintext outputs contain no unfinished content.
notes: Final design review: render only pinned published heads, including restoration from Trash. Acknowledge unfinished-only changes as no-op export records; Finish emits its own event. Never-published entries create no files/tombstones.

title: Implement consistent full backup and verified restore
description: Implement versioned consistent snapshots including all retained revisions, draft heads, plans/progress, metadata and provenance. Restore into new or replace journal with staged validation and pre-restore backup; no merge.
acceptance_criteria: Restore preserves stable IDs/history/relationships; corrupt backup leaves live journal unchanged; exports stay paused until destination reassociation; cache and device paths excluded.

title: Prepare product and architecture foundation
description: Capture agreed requirements and proposed policies for desktop rewrite; integrate data, UX and export reviews. Architecture is a proposal pending user review. Documents define behavior; Beads owns task status.
notes:
Prepared docs/PRODUCT.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, DATA-MODEL.md, PORTABILITY.md and decision 0001 through three focused agent reviews. Private GitHub repo created; work performed in design/foundation linked worktree. User-confirmed scope is distinguished from proposed scheduling, SQLite/stack, autosave and finished-head policies. Epic sj-5nz has 11 dependent tasks; sj-5nz.1 owns user policy review. No application scaffold or native test claims. Final consistency validation and push remain for this setup task.
Validation: all local Markdown links resolve; 13 JSONL issue records parse, all dependency references resolve and blocking graph has no cycles. Final cross-document agent review found three boundary gaps (pending Finish generation, draft export leak, no-op change cursor); all corrected. No app code or native tests executed.
close_reason: Design foundation prepared and independently reviewed; user policy review remains open in sj-5nz.1, implementation remains open under sj-5nz
